verdicts.reason: The two banners are almost identical, and both have the same problems. The 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon is cut off at the bottom-left edge. The product can is so small that you can't read it. The legal text is blown up into a three-line block right under the CTA, so it competes with the button and crowds the right edge. The left cluster of logo, ribbon and product is scattered with no shared alignment. A keeps the sun icon next to the SOLSTICE wordmark, so the logo stays intact. In B the logo looks like plain text with no icon, which gives A a slight edge on brand.
